declarations.description:
A pipeline or dependency graph drawn as nodes and smooth edges on a pannable, zoomable canvas, in the spirit of
React Flow but read-only in its topology: the graph comes from the `nodes` and `edges` properties, each node carries
a FlowStatus, and edges take their style from the statuses at both ends (an edge into a running step
animates, one out of a failed step turns red, one touching a skipped step is dotted).

**Layout.** Nodes are placed by a built-in layered layout: one column (`direction="LR"`) or row (`"TB"`) per
dependency depth, siblings ordered to reduce crossings. Cycles are allowed; the edges that close them are routed
round the outside of the nodes. Dragging a node (or Alt+arrow on a focused one) switches the flow to a custom
layout, saved in `localStorage` under `storage-key` and restored on the next visit. When the graph has changed
since, the saved layout is merged: kept nodes stay where they were, new nodes are placed relative to their
already-placed neighbours, removed ones are dropped. **Auto layout** in the context menu, or `resetLayout()`,
goes back to the computed layout.

**Context menu.** Right-click, long-press, or Shift+F10 / the context-menu key on the canvas opens a
`c2-context-menu` with the view controls: zoom in, zoom out, fit view, layout direction, auto layout and lock
layout. A node has no menu of its own until `renderContextMenu` returns rows for it; the canvas rows never open on
a node. `renderContextMenu` replaces or extends the canvas rows; rows it adds fire `flow-menu-select`, except
`value="flow:details"`, which selects the node and fires `node-click`.

**Hover card.** Hovering or focusing a node opens a card next to it after `open-delay` milliseconds, with its
status, description and `details`. The pointer can move into the card, so it can hold links and buttons.
`renderCard`, or a `card:<id>` slot, replaces its content; `no-card` turns it off.

**Custom nodes.** `renderNode` returns the body of each node (a Lit template, a DOM node or a string), or a
framework renders it into the `node:<id>` slot. Handles, dragging, edges and the card still come from the flow.

**Keyboard.** One node is in the tab order; arrow keys follow the edges (forward to the next step, back to the
previous one, across to a sibling of the same rank), Enter selects, Alt+arrow moves the node (8px, 24px with
Shift), Ctrl/⌘ + `+` and Ctrl/⌘ + `-` zoom and Ctrl/⌘ + `0` fits the view, while focus is in the flow (the
browser's page zoom keeps those keys everywhere else). Ctrl/⌘ + wheel zooms; a plain wheel keeps scrolling the page.

slots.description: Body of the node whose `id` is `{id}`, e.g. `slot="node:build"`. Replaces `renderNode` and the default body for that node.
slots.name: node:{id}

slots.description: Content of the hover card of node `{id}`. Replaces `renderCard` and the default card for that node.
slots.name: card:{id}

members.name: nodes
members.description: The steps. A property, or a JSON attribute.

members.name: edges
members.description: The dependencies between steps. A property, or a JSON attribute.

members.name: direction
members.description: Main axis of the auto layout. The user can switch it from the context menu; the choice is saved with the layout.

members.name: edgeType
members.description: Edge shape: smooth curves or rounded orthogonal segments.

members.name: storageKey
members.description: `localStorage` key the custom layout and direction are saved under. Empty disables persistence.

members.name: locked
members.description: Turns off moving nodes; panning, zooming, selection and the hover card still work.

members.name: selected
members.description: Id of the selected node, or `null`.

members.name: noCard
members.description: Turns off the hover card.

members.name: noContextMenu
members.description: Turns off the context menu, so the browser shows its own.

members.name: openDelay
members.description: Delay before the hover card opens, in milliseconds.

members.name: closeDelay
members.description: Delay before the hover card closes once the pointer or focus has left the node and the card, in milliseconds.

members.name: renderNode
members.description: Body of each node; see FlowRenderer. A property only, since it holds a function.

members.name: renderCard
members.description: Content of the hover card; see FlowRenderer. A property only.

members.name: renderContextMenu
members.description: Rows of the context menu; see FlowContextMenuRenderer. A property only.

members.name: pinned
members.description: Positions the user chose (or that were restored): the input of the merge on every re-layout.

members.name: viewTouched
members.description: The user panned or zoomed, so a resize no longer refits the view.

type.text: { id: string; startX: number; startY: number; origin: FlowPoint; moved: boolean; pointerId: number } | null
{ startX: number; startY: number; tx: number; ty: number; moved: boolean; pointerId: number } | null

members.name: fitView
members.description: Scales and centres the view so every node is visible, never above 100%.

members.name: getLayout
members.description: The current position of every node, rounded to whole pixels.

members.name: setLayout
members.description: Applies a custom layout (merged like a restored one) and saves it under `storage-key`.

members.name: resetLayout
members.description: Discards the custom layout, clears it from storage and animates back to the auto layout.

members.name: measure
members.description: Measures every node; a size that changed re-runs the layout, so custom bodies and late fonts are accounted for.

members.name: animateFrom
members.description: Moves every node from `from` to its current position, and the view to the fit of the new layout.

members.name: nearest
members.description: Of `candidates`, the one closest to `id` on the cross axis: arrowing forward goes straight ahead first.

members.name: stopMenuSelect
members.description: The rows' own `menu-select` bubbles out of the menu; the flow reports it as `flow-menu-select` instead.

events.name: layout-change
events.description: The user moved a node, switched direction or went back to auto layout, or `setLayout()` was called. Does not bubble.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: The selected node changed through the user. `detail.selected` is its id, or `null`. Does not bubble.

events.name: node-click
events.description: A node was clicked, activated with Enter or Space, or chosen with a `flow:details` context-menu row. Does not bubble.
A context-menu row added by `renderContextMenu` was activated, with the node it was opened on. Does not bubble.
events.name: flow-menu-select
